author: c47_build_recovery
behavior: Normal production build runs first and writes an immutable v2 build record; graph-only success never substitutes for a build.
Graph export reuses exact normalized build arguments, profile, export root and explicit relwithdebinfo/eight-worker guard configuration; it adds only dump-json-graph and dump-graph-to-file.
Both stages bind clean source revisions before and after; graph sidecar binds build-record bytes, exact export arguments, explicit configuration, graph identity and guarded success.
Future capture requires that strict successful-build/graph binding and saves both immutable record identities in the receipt.
Existing v1 receipts, including current C31, retain their existing verification route without claiming a new historical binding or requiring recapture.
Export-graph CLI supports retrying only graph generation from a successful new-style build record.
Current C31 manually recovered build/export records are not automatically upgraded and cannot be recaptured as new-style proof without a new recorded lifecycle.
limitations: Independent source review and actual future prepare/export/capture remain pending.
Only explicit guard arguments/configuration and helper bytes are bound; this does not introduce an ambient user-config/environment snapshot system.
Existing C31 evidence remains under its recorded v1 provenance rather than being relabeled as v2.
